name: SHEIN Global Holdings Limited
summary: SHEIN Global Holdings Limited operates an online retail platform for fashion and lifestyle products in China, the United States, the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United Arab Emirates, and Singapore. It offers EZWear, wardrobe essentials, beauty womenswear, activewear, casual wear, loungewear, swimwear, and athleisure products. It also offers footwear, accessories, beauty, home, and lifestyle products through its mobile applications and websites. It operates under the brand names SHEIN, MOTF, SHEGLAM, DAZY, ROMWE, Glowmode, Anewsta, Musera, and Aralina.
